name: Fly
summary: Grants a willing creature a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

stats.effect: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target gains a {ref:glossary/fly-speed} of 60 feet and can hover. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall.
stats.higherLevels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.
